item.title: Wyoming · The purpose of this meeting is to finalize its interim work. The Select Committee will review bill drafts and hear testimony on: 1) planning omnibus bill; 2) construction omnibus bill; 3) Belle Fourche River Compact; and 4) stormwater study update. The meeting will be held in-person in Cheyenne and remotely with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov). A limited number of participants can sign up to provide public comment virtually for a specified agenda item during the Committee's upcoming meeting.
